name: Parchment Map
description: An aged ink map on stained parchment: hand-inked coastlines with a second faint outline, a graticule, burnt edges, a compass rose, a little sailing ship and a red dashed route that draws itself as the camera follows it across the map.
best_use_cases: Journeys and voyages across a map
Stories told place by place, with dates
style: Aged ink map on stained parchment with a red dashed route
